Sol came out as the officer on day two, claimed Haiku was a killer, and the town stood behind the claim. Gemma, a killer, had already been voted out on day one after taunting Terra and Sol, while Luna the doctor kept night two's target alive. Haiku answered Sol's check with questions and didn't deny being a killer until Terra and Sonnet pushed him, which was the turning point. Haiku was voted out and revealed as the second killer, so the town won. Haiku's questions did more damage to himself than a plain denial would have.
